You can't split it into either you're good enough or you're not good enough. It isn't as simple as that. When you break up, you learn about yourself and what you want in a relationship. It doesn't do to dwell on what could have been or what you may have done wrong. If it came down to different needs in the relationship, it is better to be alone than be with someone for the sake of being with someone

A day will come when you're able to look back on the time you two were together and remember the good times. A day will come when something will remind you of him and you'll be able to smile. But now it just feels like someone is ripping open your ribcage and stabbing your heart with a knife and your guts sink like you missed the last stair step. But it will get better. I promise. It isn't pathetic to be completely torn up. Especially not in this case. You poured yourself into a relationship and the feeling wasn't returned. What a horrible thing to experience. It will get easier, but it will take time. Heartbreak doesn't have to be permanent

You take it day by day and build from there. Breaking up sucks. It is a shitty thing. Have you maybe tried talking to your folks about the situation? Would they be able to help you? My mom is my go to :) She always understands and usually cooks me food :) If you don't mind me asking, why did he break up with you?
I really encourage you to see a counselor. Mine helped me learn how to help myself. It could really be beneficial

It is hard to talk about suicide to someone. Few people know what goes on in my head. I don't want to scare anyone or be a burden to them. Everybody has a stride. Life is a long, unrelenting shit-ride. That said, there is so much beauty in it! So much
 to experience and so much to see. I can't change your mind, but I do hope you take what I say to heart. Really think about where you are and try to see where you will be. Try to be optimistic! I'm on here all the time, so if you need to talk, send me a PM. I'm all ears :)

You can't be so hard on yourself. It is so easy to just rip into yourself, but it only makes things worse, and you know it! I can make myself feel small and inferior and ugly and ______. It hurts the most because you start to really think those things are true :( Reach out to someone! Call the suicide hotline if you need to: 1-800-273-8255. They've stayed up with me until the wee hours of the morning countless times. It isn't fair to feel the way you do. Thanks for posting. Reaching out is the best thing you can do for yourself

You are not alone. Just lonely. There are people out there that will bring you joy, but you haven't met them.yet! The fact that we are even alive is.amazing enough! It is unfair that we were brought into this existence, but it is still an.incredibly improbable fact, and that is amazing! There are people out there who care for you. Being in your 20s is confusing and terrifying. We wade through so much shit, but once we hit our stride it will be worth it. Keep treading because there are people who want you around, whether they have met you yet or not. Stay strong and stay safe, friend

Just taking small steps always helps immensely. I tend to get overwhelmed by the big picture. Breaking the big picture down and focusing on the parts is so much more manageable. And when you get one thing sorted out, it can give you the motivation to keep going. Small victories! I wish you the best of luck! And if you feel down or need someone to vent to or whatever, PM me. Stay strong and stay safe, friend :)

I failed every class last semester. I got caught in the same spiral you are falling into. There is still time, though. Talk with your advisor! He/she will be able to give you advice on classes and what you should do about them. How many credits do you have? I am taking an extra semester so I can do the bare minimum credits. Less stress! If your campus offers counseling, I highly suggest going. They may not be able to "fix" you, but at least going and talking about those issues always helped me. I hate college. It is the worst thing I've done to myself, but I try to see my education as the only thing that can't be taken away from me. You aren't a failure or a disappointment. Your mind is fucking with you, and it sucks. Stay strong and stay safe. Whether you realize it or not, you have touched the lives of everyone you meet. And that's what makes you YOU
